steps.title: Green and fresh
steps.body: Sauvignon Blanc suits goat's cheese, a Loire classic with Sancerre, salads, green vegetables, asparagus, herbs, seafood, sushi and Thai dishes with lime and coriander. Its acidity cuts through fried food. Oaked Bordeaux whites suit richer fish and white meat.

steps.title: Service and age
steps.body: Serve at 7 to 10 degrees. Most Sauvignon Blanc is best within one to three years. Top Sancerre, Pouilly-Fumé and Pessac-Léognan can age 10 to 20 years, gaining honey, smoke and mineral notes.

steps.prompt: Which cheese is a classic Loire match for Sancerre?
steps.explanation: Crottin de Chavignol comes from a village in Sancerre.

steps.body: Sauvignon Blanc's green notes make it one of the few wines that pairs with asparagus and green salads.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Sauvignon suits goat's cheese, greens and herbs
Top Loire and Bordeaux wines age 10 to 20 years
